::: {#exm-contrapositive}
#### Contrapositives

- The contrapositive of "if $x$ is a human, then $x$ is a mammal"
  is "if $x$ is not a mammal, then $x$ is not a human".
- In @exr-sum-odd, $P$ is "$x + y$ is odd" and $Q$ is "$x \ne y$".
  The negation of $Q$ is "$x = y$" (@def-not),
  so the contrapositive is "if $x = y$, then $x + y$ is not odd",
  which is what @sol-sum-odd proved.

:::
